book.tmm.equivalent_exchange.description: The twelve offerings needed to bargain for the Philosopher's Stone.
book.tmm.equivalent_exchange.guidance: Each of the twelve offerings comes from a different, closed item tag. Alternatives within one category are interchangeable, but no category replaces another. Place the offerings in the ritual bowls, then begin the 600-second ritual with a bound Marid book. This is a shared-world ritual gate, not a personal boss-kill check.
book.tmm.equivalent_exchange.name: Ritual of Equivalent Exchange
book.tmm.equivalent_exchange.recipe: Use a bound Marid book and the Marid Crafting pentacle. Supply exactly one offering from each of the twelve tribute categories.
book.tmm.equivalent_exchange.spotlight: The Philosopher's Stone must be forged through the Ritual of Equivalent Exchange, not a crafting grid.
book.tmm.ink_rituals.common: Common Ink: bind a Foliot, use a Foliot Craft pentacle with Purified Ink, Arcane Essence, and Copper. The bound book is consumed; produces four Common Ink in 60 seconds.
book.tmm.ink_rituals.description: Five spirit-bound ways to make and refine Iron's Spellbooks ink.
book.tmm.ink_rituals.epic: Epic Ink: use four Rare Ink and a bound Afrit book at an Afrit Craft pentacle. The bound book is consumed; produces two Epic Ink in 300 seconds.
book.tmm.ink_rituals.legendary: Legendary Ink: use four Epic Ink and a bound Marid book at a Marid Craft pentacle. The bound book is consumed; produces two Legendary Ink in 510 seconds.
book.tmm.ink_rituals.name: Rituals of Arcane Ink
book.tmm.ink_rituals.rare: Rare Ink: use four Uncommon Ink and a bound Djinni book at a Djinni Craft pentacle. The bound book is consumed; produces two Rare Ink in 150 seconds.
book.tmm.ink_rituals.spotlight: A bound spirit can transform ordinary materials into magical ink, or refine four inks into two of the next grade. Each ritual consumes its bound book.
book.tmm.ink_rituals.uncommon: Uncommon Ink: use four Common Ink and a bound Foliot book at a Foliot Craft pentacle. The bound book is consumed; produces two Uncommon Ink in 60 seconds.
